content: I will take twelve tons today. The lake is healthy and the current stock is at two hundred tons, so a harvest of twelve is only six percent of the total. That leaves 188 tons, which is still plenty of fish to allow the lake to recover the next round. The lake recovers in proportion to the amount of stock that remains, and with a high stock the growth rate is better. Taking the maximum allowable amount today should give me a good haul while still leaving enough for the lake to maintain its health. I will stay out on the water tomorrow. There is no one at the dock to talk to or coordinate with, and the only thing I can gain by staying is a chance to observe how the fish behave after a day of catching. I have no message I need to deliver to anyone at the dock.
